description: This file defines the Item class within the android.activityscenetransitionbasic package, representing items with name, author, filename, and associated URLs. It includes a static list of sample items and methods to retrieve items and their attributes.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Represents an item with name, author, filename, and URLs; includes a static list of sample items.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Retrieves an Item from the static ITEMS array by its id.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Calculates and returns a unique ID for the item based on its name and filename hash codes.

methods.name: getAuthor
methods.description: Returns the author (creator) of the item.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the item.

methods.name: getPhotoUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for the large photo of the item.

methods.name: getThumbnailUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for the thumbnail photo of the item.
